coverage_explanation: Tests both local buttons, both serial light commands, newline and idle framing, buzzer activity, operation-count growth, and repeated counter reset. Exact counting rules, button hold/repeat behavior, buzzer frequency/duration, and initial light state are unspecified; the suite does not impose those choices.
assumptions: Uses bench defaults: D2 and D3 buttons connect to GND and use INPUT_PULLUP; the D13 LED is active HIGH.
D6 drives a passive buzzer, consistent with the authoritative tone_output role.

COUNT_RESET resets the displayed accumulated operation count to zero. The requirement does not specify whether redundant light commands or held buttons count repeatedly, so these cases are not assigned exact expected counts.
BEEP frequency and duration are missing. Only carrier activity following the command is checked, not a particular frequency or duration.
The reference chooses one count per debounced button press or recognized non-reset command and a 200 ms, 1000 Hz beep; these choices are not required by the checks.
